policy: Two domain-specific positive references. Extract transferable mechanisms only; never copy wording, mix domains, score benchmark source text, or automatically use either benchmark as few-shot copy.

non_transferable: Do not copy the original cover or opening verbatim.
Do not transplant customer, amount, product, season or art direction into an unrelated project.
Do not upgrade USER_PROVIDED to independently VERIFIED without original evidence.
Do not present the tool as the final purchased deliverable when the value is original product-ready artwork.
Do not copy distinctive suspense phrases.
Do not call multi-platform distribution viral spread without a traceable sharing mechanism.
Do not claim backend interaction-data analysis without exported data or an authorized interface.
Do not claim a solo creator or small team can independently complete the workflow without a non-expert test.
